```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, out.width = "100%")
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
theme_set(theme_bw())
pd <- position_dodge(0.5)

# Read in simulation parms (and pop truth) -----
load("./simdata/simParms.RData")
parms <- parms %>%
  dplyr::select(pop, mech, sampsize,
                rho_ya.z, or_y, or_a,
                mu)

# Read in all estimators ----
getres <- function(x)
{
  load(x)
  return(res)
}

# Gold standard estimator
filelist <- fs::dir_ls("./simresults/", regexp = "gold")
stack_gold <- filelist %>% 
  map(\(x) getres(x)) %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
  dplyr::select(probtype, pop, rep, est_P:ub_P)

# Naive NP estimator
filelist <- fs::dir_ls("./simresults/", regexp = "naive")
stack_naive <- filelist %>% 
  map(\(x) getres(x)) %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
  dplyr::select(pop, mech, sampsize, rep, est_NP:ub_NP)

# Combine Naive and Gold
stack_naive1 <- stack_naive %>%
  add_column(probtype = "SRS")
stack_naive2 <- stack_naive %>%
  add_column(probtype = "STR")
stack_naive_gold <- bind_rows(stack_naive1, stack_naive2) %>%
  full_join(stack_gold)
# stack_naive_gold %>%
#   group_by(pop, mech, sampsize, probtype) %>%
#   tally()
rm(stack_naive, stack_naive1, stack_naive2, stack_gold)

# PPMM direct application
filelist <- fs::dir_ls("./simresults/", regexp = "ppmmdirect")
stack_ppmmdirect <- filelist %>% 
  map(\(x) getres(x)) %>%
  list_rbind()

# PPMM-Reg
filelist <- fs::dir_ls("./simresults/", regexp = "ppmmreg_")
stack_ppmmreg <- filelist %>% 
  map(\(x) getres(x)) %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
  # filter to only original 9 NP selection mechanisms
  filter(mech <= 9) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(est_NP:ub_NP, num_s_equals_1))

# Chen methods (IPW / MI / DR)
filelist <- fs::dir_ls("./simresults/", regexp = "chen")
stack_chen <- filelist %>% 
  map(\(x) getres(x)) %>%
  list_rbind()

# Shadow variable methods
filelist <- fs::dir_ls("./simresults/", regexp = "shadow")
stack_shadow <- filelist %>% 
  map(\(x) getres(x)) %>%
  list_rbind()

# Merge estimators -----
all <- stack_naive_gold %>%
  left_join(stack_chen) %>%
  left_join(stack_ppmmdirect) %>%
  left_join(stack_ppmmreg) %>%
  left_join(stack_shadow)
  
rm(stack_chen, stack_naive_gold, stack_ppmmdirect, stack_ppmmreg, stack_shadow, filelist, getres)

# Make long and merge in parms -----
long <- all %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(starts_with("se"), or_shadowdr, orse_shadowdr)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(probtype, pop, mech, sampsize, rep), 
               names_to = c(".value", "method"), 
               names_sep="_" ) %>%
  left_join(parms) %>%
  mutate(bias = est - mu,
         relbias = bias/mu,
         cover = (lb < mu & ub > mu),
         width = ub - lb)
```

**Set 1: Ignorable selection with a shadow variable**

OR(Y) = 1 and OR(A) = 1 --> 3 scenarios: Cor(Y,A|Z) = {0.2, 0.5, 0.8}

**Set 2: Ignorable selection without a shadow variable**

OR(Y) = 1 and OR(A) != 1 --> 6 scenarios: OR(A) = {1.1, 2} and Cor(Y,A|Z) = {0.2, 0.5, 0.8}

**Set 3: Nonignorable selection with a shadow variable**

OR(Y) != 1 and OR(A) = 1 --> 6 scenarios: OR(Y) = {1.1, 2} and Cor(Y,A|Z) = {0.2, 0.5, 0.8}

**Set 4: Nonignorable selection without a shadow variable**

OR(Y) != 1 and OR(A) != 1 --> 12 scenarios: OR(Y) = {1.1, 2} and OR(A) = {1.1, 2} and Cor(Y,A|Z) = {0.2, 0.5, 0.8}

```{r}
# summarize across replicates
part1 <- long %>%
  group_by(probtype, pop, mech, sampsize, mu, rho_ya.z, or_y, or_a, method) %>%
  summarize(nreps = sum(!is.na(est)))
part2 <- long %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  group_by(probtype, pop, mech, sampsize, mu, rho_ya.z, or_y, or_a, method) %>%
  summarize(nreps = n(), 
            mean_est = mean(est),
            mean_bias = mean(bias),
            sd_bias = sd(bias),
            lb_bias = mean_bias - 1.96*sd_bias/sqrt(nreps),
            ub_bias = mean_bias + 1.96*sd_bias/sqrt(nreps),
            mean_cover = mean(cover),
            sd_cover = sqrt(mean_cover*(1-mean_cover)),
            lb_cover = pmax(0, mean_cover - 1.96*sd_cover/sqrt(nreps)),
            ub_cover = pmin(1, mean_cover + 1.96*sd_cover/sqrt(nreps)),
            mean_width = mean(width),
            median_width = median(width))
sumstats <- left_join(part1, part2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(relbias = 100*mean_bias/mu,
         method_f = factor(method, 
                           levels = c("P", "NP",
                                      "chenmi","chenipw","chendr","ppmmreg0","ppmm0",
                                      "ppmmreg1","shadowdrP",
                                      "ppmmreg","ppmm","ppmm1"), 
                           labels = c("Prob Samp Est", "Naive NP Est",
                                      "MI", "IPW", "DR", "PPMM-Reg(\u03c6=0)", "SMUB(\u03c6=0)",
                                      "PPMM-Reg(\u03c6=1)", "Shadow Var",
                                      "PPMM-Reg", "SMUB", "SMUB(\u03c6=1)")),
         set = case_when(or_y == 1 & or_a == 1 ~ 1,
                         or_y == 1 & or_a != 1 ~ 2,
                         or_y != 1 & or_a == 1 ~ 3,
                         or_y != 1 & or_a != 1 ~ 4),
         set_f = case_when(set == 1 ~ "Set 1: Ignorable w/Shadow Var",
                           set == 2 ~ "Set 2: Ignorable w/o Shadow Var",
                           set == 3 ~ "Set 3: Nonignorable w/Shadow Var",
                           set == 4 ~ "Set 4: Nonignorable w/o Shadow Var"),
         estimator_group = case_when(method %in% c("P", "NP") ~ " ",
                                     method %in% c("chenmi","chenipw","chendr","ppmmreg0","ppmm0") ~ "Ignorable",
                                     method %in% c("ppmmreg1","shadowdrP") ~ "Shadow",
                                     method %in% c("ppmmreg","ppmm","ppmm1") ~ "Other")) %>%
  mutate(estimator_group = fct_relevel(estimator_group, c(" ", "Ignorable", "Shadow", "Other")))


# labels for facets
rho_ya.z.labs <- c("Cor(Y,A|Z) = 0.2", "Cor(Y,A|Z) = 0.5", "Cor(Y,A|Z) = 0.8")
names(rho_ya.z.labs) <- c("0.2", "0.5", "0.8")
or_a.labs <- c("OR(A) = 1.1", "OR(A) = 2")
names(or_a.labs) <- c(1.1, 2)
or_y.labs <- c("OR(Y) = 1.1", "OR(Y) = 2")
names(or_y.labs) <- c(1.1, 2)
```

Methods that do not have 1000 replicates (b/c of convergence problems):

```{r}
# methods that do not have 1000 reps
sumstats %>%
  filter(nreps >0 & nreps < 1000) %>%
  dplyr::select(method_f, probtype, sampsize, set_f, rho_ya.z, or_y, or_a, nreps)
```

Notes:

* When OR(Y) = 1 --> Selection is **ignorable**  
  * phi=0 for PPMM/PPMM-Reg  
  * Chen methods should work  
* When OR(Y) > 1 --> Selection is **nonignorable**   
  * phi>1 for PPMM/PPMM-Reg  
* When OR(A) = 1 --> A **is** a shadow variable  
  * phi=1 for PPMM-Reg, 0<phi<1 for PPMM  
* When OR(A) > 1 --> A **is not** a shadow variable   
  * phi<1 for PPMM-Reg, 0<phi<1 for PPMM

## Set 1: Ignorable w/Shadow Variable

OR(Y) = 1 and OR(A) = 1 --> 3 scenarios: Cor(Y,A|Z) = {0.2, 0.5, 0.8}

Methods that should be unbiased are:

* PPMM-Reg(phi=0)  
* SMUB(phi=0)  
* Chen methods (DR, IPW, MI)  
* Shadow Variable (P)
* PPMM-Reg(phi=1) and PPMM-Reg will also be unbiased, because since A isn't associated with selection, the estimates will not vary as a function of phi (the proxy mean is the same in the selected and nonselected sample)

### Bias {.tabset}

```{r, include = FALSE}
# getting ranges for plots
sumstats %>% 
  filter(set == 1) %>%
  summarize(min_bias_lb = min(lb_bias, na.rm=TRUE),
            max_bias_ub = max(ub_bias, na.rm=TRUE))
```

```{r, fig.asp=0.5}
g <- sumstats %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_rev(method_f), x = mean_bias, color = factor(rho_ya.z), shape = factor(rho_ya.z))) + 
  geom_point(size = 1, position = pd) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lb_bias, xmax = ub_bias), position = pd, width = 0.3) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") + 
  labs(x = "Empirical Bias", y = " ", color = "Cor(Y,A|Z)", shape = "Cor(Y,A|Z)") + 
  facet_grid(estimator_group ~ ., 
             scales = "free", space = "free_y") + 
  theme(strip.background.y = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0,"cm")) +
  lims(x = c(-0.3, 0.16))
g1 <- g + filter(sumstats, set == 1 & sampsize == 1 & probtype == "SRS")
g2 <- g + filter(sumstats, set == 1 & sampsize == 2 & probtype == "SRS")
g3 <- g + filter(sumstats, set == 1 & sampsize == 1 & probtype == "STR")
g4 <- g + filter(sumstats, set == 1 & sampsize == 2 & probtype == "STR")
# ggplot_build(g4)$layout$panel_scales_x
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_rev(method_f), x = mean_bias, color = factor(rho_ya.z), shape = factor(rho_ya.z))) +

  facet_grid(sampsize_f ~ probtype, 
             scales = "free", space = "free_y") +
```

```{r, fig.asp=0.5}
g <- sumstats %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_cover)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_rev(method_f), x = mean_cover, color = factor(rho_ya.z), shape = factor(rho_ya.z))) +

  theme(strip.background.y = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0,"cm")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,1))
```

## Set 3: Non-Ignorable w/Shadow Variable

OR(Y) != 1 and OR(A) = 1 --> 6 scenarios: OR(Y) = {1.1, 2} and Cor(Y,A|Z) = {0.2, 0.5, 0.8}

Methods that should be unbiased are:

* PPMM-Reg(phi=1)  
* Shadow Variable (P)  

### Bias {.tabset}

```{r, include = FALSE}
# getting ranges for plots
sumstats %>% 
  filter(set == 3) %>%
  group_by(or_a, or_y) %>%
  summarize(min_bias_lb = min(lb_bias, na.rm=TRUE),
            max_bias_ub = max(ub_bias, na.rm=TRUE))
```

```{r, fig.asp=0.5}
g <- sumstats %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_rev(method_f), x = mean_bias, color = factor(rho_ya.z), shape = factor(rho_ya.z))) + 
  geom_point(size = 1, position = pd) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lb_bias, xmax = ub_bias), position = pd, width = 0.3) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") + 
  labs(x = "Bias", y = " ", color = "Cor(Y,A|Z)", shape = "Cor(Y,A|Z)") + 
  facet_grid(estimator_group ~ or_y, 
             labeller = labeller(or_y = or_y.labs), 
             scales = "free", space = "free_y") + 
  theme(strip.background.y = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0,"cm")) +
```

## Set 4: Non-Ignorable w/NO Shadow Variable

OR(Y) != 1 and OR(A) != 1 --> 12 scenarios: OR(Y) = {1.1, 2} and OR(A) = {1.1, 2} and Cor(Y,A|Z) = {0.2, 0.5, 0.8}

No methods will be unbiased (b/c for SMUB and PPMM-Reg the phi value will be somewhere in {0,1})

But SMUB and PPMM-Reg with uniform prior should have decent coverage

### Bias {.tabset}

```{r, include = FALSE}
# getting ranges for plots
sumstats %>% 
  filter(set == 4) %>%
  group_by(or_a, or_y) %>%
  summarize(min_bias_lb = min(lb_bias, na.rm=TRUE),
            max_bias_ub = max(ub_bias, na.rm=TRUE))
```

```{r, fig.asp=0.5}
g <- sumstats %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_rev(method_f), x = mean_bias, color = factor(rho_ya.z), shape = factor(rho_ya.z))) + 
  geom_point(size = 1, position = pd) +

  labs(x = "Bias", y = " ", color = "Cor(Y,A|Z)", shape = "Cor(Y,A|Z)") + 
  facet_grid(estimator_group ~ or_y + or_a,

                                      or_a == 2   & or_y == 2   ~ scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-10, 3.8))))
```
